easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
description:
Activate Ticking Gnomes by sacrificing it.
When Ticking Gnomes dies, Yedora triggers, returning Ticking Gnomes from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Ticking Gnomes enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ticking Gnomes by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Ticking Gnomes face-up.
Resolve the Ticking Gnomes ability from step 1.
Repeat.
